name: MSN LPBonus accrues FIST rewards at a manipulated pair reserve
summary: MSN's transfer hooks drive LPBonus, which on each fee accrual adds swapped FIST to a per-share index divided by the FIST/MSN pair's live MSN reserve, and pays LP removals from that index. With flash-swapped FIST the attacker registered an LP position, crushed the pair's MSN reserve, let an accrual run at the crushed reserve, and removed dust LP to claim 1.44m FIST against about 0.94m funded, draining LPBonus's FIST.
notes: Both contracts are unverified; the mechanism follows the PoC's bytecode reading and the trace. LPBonus's reset is the owner setting the FIST/MSN pair in LPBonus and MSN (CreatePair, one tx, 31 blocks after LPBonus's deployment). MSN's reset is the owner's setStartTradeTime (0x9b51d8d5, slot 0xb), which first opened trading (rule 8): MSN was deployed with a start time of 10^40, and the anchor replayed with that value reverts at its first MSN buy, where MSN's transfer out of the pair fails with TradeNotStarted. The time it set, 14:08 UTC on 2025-09-24, passed 51 minutes later. MSN's earlier OpenAddLiquidity(true) and setWhiteList(LPBonus, true) were not needed: the anchor replayed with either undone drains the same 564,807 FIST.

Loss is LPBonus's net FIST outflow at DefiLlama's price; the attacker realised 92,607 USDT after its sale and fees. Scanning LPBonus's FIST transfers from MSN's deployment (block 62253725, before LPBonus's) to the anchor finds no earlier exploit: no earlier transaction took more than 20,229 FIST from LPBonus. The largest, 0xa9ca5ae8 (20,229) and 0x72125842 (18,243), are reward payouts spread over 26 and 49 holders of at most 2,513 FIST each, and 0xef1edb02 (10,000) went to the deployer 0x1a868b70 in its own call; the anchor paid 1,442,166 FIST to the attacker's contract in one transfer.
